idle: Six-frame calm loop: subtle breathing, one natural blink, and stable planted feet. First and last frames seamlessly loop.
running-right: Eight-frame rightward locomotion: smooth alternating strides, balanced posture, and active movement.
running-left: Eight-frame leftward locomotion: independently drawn leftward run with balanced posture. Preserve any directional emblems or numbers.
waving: Four-frame friendly greeting: relaxed standing pose, hand rises, gives a clear friendly wave, then returns.
jumping: Five-frame dynamic leap: slight crouch, vertical jump up, apex pose, landing, and settle back onto baseline.
failed: Eight-frame disappointment reaction: brief reaction to a missed attempt, shoulders/head lower, quiet pause, then calm recovery.
waiting: Six-frame waiting loop: thoughtful standing pose, subtle rhythmic breathing, and alert stance.
running: Six-frame forward-facing locomotion: energetic forward running motion with alternating limbs for stationary desktop work mode.
review: Six-frame review and inspection loop: head/gaze turns to scan, brief thoughtful pause, and smooth return to ready stance.
